svg.title: Agent inspector: current sight and sampled inputs
svg.desc: Illustration, not an experiment result. The board uses current step 120 geometry; the radar uses genuine top-k features from a controlled earlier pose. Action probabilities are illustrative.
svg.text: Agent inspector: two clocks, one replay
Illustration • controlled inputs and example probabilities, not a captured experiment
Blue tiles: legal sight from the current position.
Walls occlude; river cells can extend the range.
The selected predator has moved since its last sample.
A target visible now may be absent from the old radar.
Other animals on the board remain visible to you;
the highlighted area shows what the animal can see.
Dots are recorded target slots, not every visible entity. Probabilities describe preferences, not guaranteed actions.
